 Oral Order

2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Bajpatti P.S. Case No. 233 of 2024 for the offence registered under Sections 363, 366A, 376, 498(A), 323, 34 of the IPC, Section 8 of the POCSO Act and Section 4 of the D.P. Act lodged on 27.08.2024 by the informant.

3. Though, the mediation has failed, it is the joint request by both the parties that a chance be given to the couple to come to an amicable settlement, in that background, let the couple be present before this Court on 12.09.2025.

4. List this case on 12.09.2025 as tied-up matter.
(Rajiv Roy, J) priyanka/-
